title: Edge ops pocket list — Simon's quickrun
content:
Sprint-size personal scratchpad for the late afternoon shift. Use this as the canonical short-running checklist + ephemeral notes I can copy into handoff. NOT a formal runbook — just quick context, commands, and decisions.

Context: we are stabilizing small-edge pools in eu-west-1 after the 03/10 kernel update. Observed 2x eviction rate on small-t4 pools when burst traffic from demo infra spikes. Need to rebalance and leave notes for night team.

Top priorities (do this in order):
1) Drain suspicious nodes in pool 'edge-eu-t4-small-3' with gentle cordon -> drain, leaving critical api-hosts alone. Goal: reduce preempt rate, keep capacity >= 70% for customer traffic.
2) Patch the NNP daemonset image to 0.9.3 (already in PR) on canary 2 nodes, watch p95 latency. If p95 increases by >40ms, rollback.
3) Tune batching policy for chat-shard-14: reduce max_batch_size from 32 -> 24 for nodes on t4 to reduce latency spikes.

Quick commands (copy-paste):
- Cordons/drain: kubectl cordon node/$NODE && kubectl drain node/$NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
- Check GPU usage: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 2
- Check runtime logs: kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/runtime-proxy -c runtime --since=15m | grep --line-buffered "prefix_cache_miss"
- Force small canary rollout: kubectl -n infra set image ds/nnp-daemon nnp=image-registry/redwood/nnp:0.9.3 --record

Observed metrics snapshot (15:30 local):
- pool edge-eu-t4-small-3: total nodes 8, ready 6, allocatable GPUs 8, avg_util 63%, p95 latency 320ms (chat), evictions last 24h: 4
- chat-shard-14: rps burst 250 -> cold p95 285ms -> after batching change want <250ms

Notes-to-self:
- If drain leaves any pods in Terminating > 10m, check for stuck PVCs (mostly test agents). kubectl get pv|grep stuck -> then kubectl patch pv ... (note: don't force delete prod PVCs).
- For memory OOM suspects, look at coredumps in /var/log/containers on the host (tar and upload to /tmp/simon-ooms).

Decisions made during shift:
- Will not scale up small pool at this time (cost), prefer conservative drain + patching.
- Canary of nnp 0.9.3 allowed if two green canary nodes show p95 delta < +20ms for 20 minutes. Otherwise revert.

Follow-ups / Tickets to create or update:
- JIRA-ENG-1147: follow up on edge pool eviction root cause (add kernel config diff and node logs).
- Create quick postmortem note if eviction count > 6 in next 48h.
- PR 862: add healthcheck probe timeout change to 6s for the runtime-proxy (linked above).

Handoff for night shift (actionable bullets):
- @Ishaan: watch chat-shard-14 p95 for next 4h; if p95 > 350ms for >10m escalate and consider reverting batching change.
- @Maya: verify canary nodes (nn p 0.9.3) after 30m and sign off or revert. If sign-off, schedule staged rollout 2x nodes / 30m.
- Save logs: tar -czf /tmp/edge-eu-logs-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).tgz /var/log/pods/edge-eu-t4-small-3 -- exclude large debug dirs. Upload to s3://redwood-dumps/edge/evictions/ (notify slack @eng-platform).

Brain-dump / ideas (very rough):
- Investigate prefix cache TTL tuning on edge nodes — short TTL may increase backend chatter and raise eviction risk. Add a small benchmark job that simulates real demo traffic and measure cache hit rate.
- Consider a scaled-down spot-block for small-pool critical routes to prevent eviction during brief bursts. Cost analysis needed.

Open questions:
- Why did one host show 98% GPU memory but only 15% compute util? (Possible stuck process or memory leak) Need to capture full ps aux + cuda-process-list during next incident.
- Is kernel patch 5.15.92-rt causing cgroups v2 misreporting leading to premature eviction? Add kernel boot logs to JIRA-ENG-1147.

Micro TODOs (can clear quickly):
- [ ] Add a brief note to PR 862 about probe timeout reasoning (done?)
- [ ] Upload /tmp/edge-eu-logs-*.tgz to S3 and paste link in #edge-ops slack
- [ ] Annotate chat-shard-14 dashboard with new batching config change and why; add expected p95 target
- [ ] Remind on-call to increase watch-dog alerting for preempt events > 3 in 1h

End of pocket list. Copy this into handoff message and mark as DONE when all micro todos checked.

-- Simon
